name: statejar
description: Verifiable memory for Claude Code: recalls what a session needs from your StateJar memory, captures the facts you state (secrets removed), and gives Claude StateJar's tools. Every recall names its handle and is an audited disclosure.

api_key.title: StateJar developer key
api_key.description: A developer key (sj_live_…) from https://statejar.com/api-keys. Kept in your system's secure credential store.

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: The scope (session) inside your StateJar account that Claude Code reads and writes. A new scope builds on your newest memory.

auto_capture.title: Capture what you say
auto_capture.description: Queue your prompts (secrets removed) and send them in batches; StateJar stores the typed facts in them, never a transcript.

recall_each_prompt.title: Recall for each prompt
recall_each_prompt.description: Before each prompt, add the memory that prompt needs as context (one audited query per prompt).

api_url.title: StateJar API URL
api_url.description: The REST API the hooks call.

mcp_url.title: StateJar MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The MCP server Claude's StateJar tools use.
